description:
This image depicts a street scene featuring a prominent street sign with the name "Webster" emblazoned in white, set against a vibrant green background. Above the sign, a banner proudly displays a red, white, and blue design, accompanied by white text that reads "100 years." The sign is mounted on a metal pole and situated on the side of a building.

In the foreground, a lamp post stands adjacent to the sign, while a tree with lush green leaves dominates the background.
